name: Minerva Aldwin
source:
A devoted assistant who always looks out for the Faeologist's well-being. 
Be it offering a refreshing beverage or tactfully fending off unwelcome visitors, she's always ready to help her admired professor. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369020/Death__Faeology/]Steam[/url]]
